gxrepl

Database replication over gxStream with mutual TLS: committed pages from a ship log, files by a scan, derived indexes kept by the copy (Linux and POSIX).

Contents

Commands
What It Does

Commands

gxrepl serve  --config FILE [--key-fd N]          the server (listens, TCP 2073)
gxrepl run    --config FILE [--key-fd N]          the client (dials, replicates until stopped)
gxrepl once   --config FILE [--set NAME]           one pass with a full verify; exit 0 = every set the same
gxrepl status --config FILE                        the status file (JSON)
gxrepl check  --config FILE                        certificates, sets and folders
gxrepl torn   --config FILE [--set NAME]           promote-check: is every copy whole and sealed
gxrepl promote --config FILE [--set NAME] [--apply] before a take over
gxrepl digest FILE [--kind btree|bytes|objects]    what a database or index holds, whatever its layout
gxrepl derived status|rebuild --config FILE [--set NAME] [--folder REL]
gxrepl shiplog DIR [--from LSN]                    list a ship log's records
gxrepl fingerprint CERT.pem / gxrepl version

What It Does

A writer that commits through a gxdJournal with the ship log on appends each commit's pages; gxrepl sends those records to the copy, which applies them through its own journal, so the copy is always one whole commit. Files without a ship log go by a scan. Folders with a commit block are copied and sealed as one unit; gxrepl torn says whether every copy is whole. Derived indexes are never sent: the copy rebuilds them (derived_apply = rebuild, the default) or keeps them object by object (incremental, with an extractor; not yet for production use).

In 7.4 every writer open or gap record gets its verify (also when it comes inside a file sync), a stream's log made again is seen, and a folder's commit block is applied only when its stream needs no other verify: while it waits, the set's status says "waiting": "waiting for verify: STREAM". The status file's "derived" object gives each derived set's mode, folders, failed, not built, rebuild needed, breaker and crashes in the last hour.

The design and every config key: utils/gxrepl/README.md; setup, watching, failover and failback: the administrator's guide; examples: replication, and on Windows replication_copy.
